item.description: Victoria police say boy, 17, communicated with offenders under username ‘Onepercent’ Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Victorian police allege a 17-year-old boy tasked others to carry out a series of arsons, home invasions and a mistaken identity kidnapping that resulted in the partial amputation of a victim’s finger during Melbourne’s hospitality wars. The boy, who was arrested on Friday afternoon, allegedly communicated with the offenders under the username “Onepercent” on the encrypted communications app Signal. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.
item.dc:creator: Nino Bucci

item.title: Honda, Toyota recall 1.6 million US vehicles over airbag rupture risk
item.description: Both car makers say there were no injuries or crashes tied to the vehicles being recalled, but defective Takata airbag inflators have been blamed for at least 28 deaths in the US and more than 400 injuries since 2009. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Labor set for historic defeat at Victorian election, political experts say
item.description: Premier Ben Carroll and Opposition Leader Jess Wilson have been campaigning at early voting centres as Victoria marks a week until the November 28 election. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Alex Sinnott and Emma D'Agostino

item.title: Device that measures strawberry skin's strength will aid breeders
item.description: Resilient strawberry varieties will be more easily identifiable thanks to a tool developed by University of Queensland engineering students. The prototype measures the strength of strawberry skin, a key breeding consideration for the Australian Strawberry Breeding Program at Queensland's Department of Primary Industries. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Authorities investigating four-minute Triple Zero outage in Canberra
item.description: Authorities are continuing to investigate what caused a temporary Triple Zero outage this week, and why its initial back-up power system failed. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Madeleine Rojahn

item.title: Boy, 11, killed after being hit by ute in regional WA
item.description: An 11-year-old boy dies after being hit by a car while crossing South Western Highway in the small town of Kirup, 220km south of Perth. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Jon Daly

item.title: The accidental outback publican
item.description: Stacy Henman cannot recall making an offer to buy the remote Tilpa Hotel but after nine months is celebrating his journey to business ownership alongside the characters of the pub. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Em Jensen

item.title: Khawaja and Warner taken off commentary as CA backs Cummins' captaincy
item.description: Fox Cricket takes Usman Khawaja and David Warner out of the firing line as Pat Cummins receives unequivocal backing from Cricket Australia. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Chris De Silva

item.title: Teens 'lucky to be alive' after stabbings at Sydney shopping centre
item.description: A 17-year-old has been charged and a 16-year-old arrested after two boys were stabbed during an alleged confrontation at a shopping centre in Sydney's north-west. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Bayer to pay $11b over claims weed killer caused cancer
item.description: The US settlement handed down in Missouri applies to Roundup weed-killer users who are ill and those who become diagnosed with non-Hodgkin lymphoma in future years. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Four people struck by lightning at NSW music festival
item.description: Wild weather caused chaos at the Strawberry Fields music festival at Tocumwal overnight. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Australia-wide rallies warn freebirths will soar under new rules
item.description: Thousands have rallied in cities and towns across the country, warning new insurance rules will lead to a "catastrophic collapse" in access to midwife-supported homebirths. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Cason Ho, Olivana Lathouris, Nandini Dhir, Jess Scully, Madigan Landry, Joshua McIntosh, Chloe Henville, and Stacey Pestrin

item.title: Ahead of 2028, a presidential campaign is building behind AOC
item.description: In the wake of the US midterms "bluenami", speculation that Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez is popular enough to be elected America's first female president has reached a fever pitch. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Annabel Bowles

item.title: Experts say AI 'spy-tech' has infiltrated Australian uni exams
item.description: It sounds like something you'd see in a James Bond film, but covert technology has made its way into Australian exam rooms and is causing concern in the education industry. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Hannah Moon

item.title: Young Iranian women risk their lives to join underground ballet network
item.description: Dance has been illegal in Iran for decades, but an underground network has emerged in a fierce act of defiance against the regime. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Brooke Young

item.title: Outback town's crime crisis needs support to match social media attention
item.description: For the people working directly with Kununurra's troubled young teenagers, support and structure are what's needed to stop criminal behaviour that's put the town on the global map for all the wrong reasons. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Giulia Bertoglio

item.title: Liberal voters expected to 'come home' in Victorian leader's seat of Kew
item.description: A returning independent candidate in Jess Wilson's home electorate is optimistic about her chances, but the local member's high profile may help the Liberals claw back voters in the formerly safe Liberal seat. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Kate Ashton

item.title: Texas inmate screams during drawn-out execution
item.description: The Texas Department of Criminal Justice has denied claims the execution of Reinaldo Dennes was "botched" after he complained of excruciating pain. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Schoolies rolls out pickleball and line dancing as teens' tastes change
item.description: Thousands of school leavers hit the Gold Coast today for the beginning of schoolies week, but numbers are down, and the annual celebration is changing. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Charmayne Allison

item.title: From Marxism to extremism: A Perth teen's descent into radicalisation
item.description: James Hollands was just 16 when he was fatally shot by police after almost killing a random stranger he stabbed with a kitchen knife — now a coroner will determine if the teenager could have been saved. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Mayes and Cason Ho

item.title: At 192cm tall, Tiny Tim could be a national cattle record breaker
item.description: A Holstein-Friesian named Tiny Tim is thought to be Australia's biggest living steer, inheriting the crown from the late legend Knickers. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: Neve Brissenden and Jacqueline Lynch

item.title: Man convicted of starting deadly 2025 LA Palisades Fire
item.description: Jonathan Rinderknecht is found guilty at his second trial of sparking last year's deadly Palisades Fire, which killed 12 people. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Petition against AI cameras at junior basketball attracts 13,000 signatures
item.description: Basketball Australia has started trialling AI-powered "smart cameras" at community games, ahead of a wider rollout, sparking concerns for some. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
item.dc:creator: George Nicoll

item.title: Hatching a plan to ensure Australia's native turtles survive and thrive
item.description: How a citizen science program is saving thousands of turtles even as researchers learn more about them. Fuente: ABC News Australia.
